newsitem.title: USA: South Jersey authority okays $330 mln viaduct.
newsitem.headline: South Jersey authority okays $330 mln viaduct.

text.p: The South Jersey Transportation Authority Wednesday ratified an agreement to build a $330 million viaduct connecting the Atlantic City Expressway to the city's marina district, where three major new resorts are planned.
The agreement paves the way for "thousands of new jobs and tens of millions in new revenue for the city and state," said Stanley Glassey, the authority's chairman.
The tab for the authority's share of the work will be $60 million. A spokesman for the agency said it would not call for a toll increase to pay for the project.

The authority will sell a $125 million bond issue as part of a financing package that also incorporates the $65 million funding responsibility of the state's Casino Redevelopment Investment Authority. Under an agreement signed January 10 by state officials and Mirage Resorts Inc CEO Steve Wynn, the financing will also include $95 million from the state Transportation Trust Fund, $55 million from fees from the projects and $55 million from Mirage.
